faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CAQM Advisor (Media & IEC Activities) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the CAQM Advisor (Media & IEC Activities) position is 15th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Advisor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired Government/Statutory/Autonomous body officials at the Director level or above, with at least fifteen years of experience in Media and IEC activities.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 63 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. How will the selected candidate be compensated?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration equivalent to their last pay drawn minus pension, plus TA. For those from non-pensionable bodies, a fixed remuneration of Rs. 1,20,000/- per month is offered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post or email.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Advisor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Advisor (Media & IEC Activities) in the Commission for Air Quality Management.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is A-12011/01/2022-Estt.-Part(1).

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Completed applications should be sent to The Under Secretary (Establishment), Commission for Air Quality Management, 16th Floor, Jawahar Vyapar Bhawan, Tolstoy Marg, New Delhi - 110001, or via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Advisor (Media & IEC Activities) position is on a contract basis.
